verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents multi-step browser automations, workflows, and per-run APIs, but nothing in the evidence describes a bulk or batch capability such as looping over a list of items, batch run submission, or acting on many records at once. Marketing lines about teams logging into 'dozens of portals' describe use cases, not a documented bulk-operation feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
